goal: Draft and verify Integrated design, reference solution and decision summary for SDA-M00-INT

in_scope: Implement only Story SDA-M00-INT from milestone SDA-MS01 at the declared output paths.

**Integrated design exercise:** Produce a one-page design brief for a document-sharing service.

**Reference solution and self-evaluation:** Reference package: assumptions register, prioritised use cases, two architecture alternatives, explicit unknowns; assess traceability and justified scope.

**Synthesis outcome map:** M00-S1: frame the brief and defend its scope; readiness diagnosis belongs to M00-L01’s companion. M00-EX1 measures this synthesis outcome using M00-L02-LO1 and M00-L02-LO2. It does not claim all module lesson outcomes. Each lesson’s separate companion remains responsible for its complete LO1/LO2 assessment, and the course portfolio must reconcile all companions before course completion.

**Decision-summary table plan:** Choose study route by demonstrated prerequisites, then use the same requirements-to-decision method in every module. Each eventual row states trigger, option, mechanism, benefit, cost, failure signal, when to avoid, and the lesson reference.
Consume validated packages from SDA-M00-L01, SDA-M00-L02 when reconciling coverage and outcomes.
out_of_scope: Other milestones and changes to the approved course baseline.
Human approval, merge and learner-facing publication.

constraints: Use English and write for middle and senior engineers with the approved entry prerequisites. Keep all learner-facing artifacts at draft status.

Use the approved SDA-v1 plan, inventory, matrix and verdict; the Primer topic map is pinned at ae9bbd7b02d90b9866215de185217d33f39ab733. Cite exact primary-source sections for technical claims and use original examples.
Two independent reviewers cover technical correctness and provenance, and actual coverage, pedagogy and language. Keep reviews bound to the exact current artifacts.

definition_of_done.text: Record exact primary-source evidence, limits and check dates, and reuse the exact approved course verdict after strict plan validation.
Commit the draft teaching and separate assessment outputs defined by the Story.
Commit both independent findings reports and matching verdicts for the current drafts.
Pass the applicable package checks and the repository checks, and record results and feedback disposition in the declared report.

acceptance_criteria.text: Implement the approved module synthesis subset and its reference/self-evaluation plan.
Decision-summary table includes trigger, option, mechanism, benefit, cost, failure signal, when to avoid and lesson reference.
Consolidate current teaching evidence for each assigned topic and reconcile every lesson and module synthesis outcome with its assessment evidence.
Each externally supported claim records a verified section, version or publication, check date, and scope. Unresolved claims are flagged.
Verify matching SDA-v1 approval and review hashes and exact story assignment before reusing the accepted verdict.
The independent review records separate correctness and source or rights findings and binds its verdict to the declared artifact hashes.
